title: Perkins monument works, McLaughlin farm equipment, Chat newspaper office, and post office
description: Photo taken before 1907, across from the bridge ramp, looking north up Main Street. On the left, Sipprelle blacksmith shop, Perkins Monument, McLaughlin Massey Harris farm machinery, Chat newspaper, the Post Office, Nixon’s General Merchant, Thomas Simms, Baird's Fruits and Confectionery, Keith and Plummer, John T. G. Carr, G. C. Watson Furniture, Montgomery Hardware, George Burtt General Store.
credit: Doris Kennedy Collection — Hartland Community Historical Society
